description: Returns the organisation's credit balance by source, plan, per-action prices and rate limit, and for an agent key its monthly budget and per-order cap. Use it before quoting a large order, or when a spend is refused, to see what remains. Free; it needs a token with account:read. Top-ups happen on mydatahub.emailmovers.com, never inside a tool. Lawful basis is UK GDPR Article 6(1)(f) legitimate interests; email audiences include corporate subscribers only by default (PECR), so sole traders and ordinary partnerships are left out unless the toggle is changed.
name: get_account

accepted_by.description: Format: a user id: usr_ followed by a 26 character ULID in upper case Crockford base32, such as usr_01JA0Q3V7XN3M9R6T1Y5W8ZAK8.

accepted.description: The organisation's acceptance of the latest version it accepted: which version, when and by whom, first time for that version. null until one is accepted. When version (the one in force) differs, the agreement is accepted again.

accepted_version.description: The latest version accepted, accepted.version; null when none was.

in_force.description: Whether the version accepted is the version in force. false when none was accepted, or an older one.

version.description: The version in force: draft until the text is approved.

Budget.description: An agent key's monthly budget in credits.

remaining.description: Credits, to one decimal place: whole at 1 credit a record, fractional only where a rule is (0.1 company-only, 1.8 outright, both proposed).

spent.description: Credits, to one decimal place: whole at 1 credit a record, fractional only where a rule is (0.1 company-only, 1.8 outright, both proposed).

BusinessDetails.description: Whether the business name and a UK business confirmation are on record, which a self-serve account needs before its first order and before it buys credits.

confirmed_at.description: When a person confirmed the business name and that it is a UK business; null until then.

name_editable.description: true for an organisation made by self-serve sign-up, whose business name PATCH /v1/account sets. false for one Emailmovers set up, which keeps the name staff gave it and needs no business details before an order.

required_before_order.description: true: an order, an enrichment or a card purchase of credits is refused with business-details-required until a person who owns the account confirms them with PATCH /v1/account. Only an organisation made by self-serve sign-up before sign-up asked for them can need them, and whether it does is set when it is made.

CreditRule.description: What one action costs in credits.

credits.description: Credits, to one decimal place: whole at 1 credit a record, fractional only where a rule is (0.1 company-only, 1.8 outright, both proposed).

status.description: confirmed is in force; proposed awaits a decision; to_confirm is a figure still being checked.

RateLimit.description: The caller's count limits and what remains in the window.

outputSchema.description: Balance, plan, per-action prices, rate limit and the calling key's budget.

account_manager.description: The named person behind Talk to us.

agreements.description: The Terms of Sale (accepted at sign-up; accepted: null for an organisation Emailmovers set up), the Data Licence and Sharing Agreement (the licence: accepted with every order, or with an agent key that orders on its own) and the Article 28 DPA (accepted with the first suppression list).

low_threshold.description: The credits.low webhook fires when the balance crosses this.

subscription_credits.description: From the plan: roll over while subscribed, up to the cap.

demo.description: A demo organisation: everything runs in test mode, nothing is charged, order records are invented, and it stops working at expires_at. null for a real account.

gbp_per_credit.description: Your plan's price per credit, excluding VAT.

id.description: Format: an API key id: key_ followed by a 26 character ULID in upper case Crockford base32, such as key_01JB3Z4Q2V7XN3M9R6T1Y5W8ZA.

key.description: The calling key and, for an agent key, its budget; null for a person.

mode.description: live keys (mdh_live_) spend real credits; test keys (mdh_test_) return synthetic data and never charge.

id.description: Format: an organisation id: org_ followed by a 26 character ULID in upper case Crockford base32, such as org_01JA0Q2V7XN3M9R6T1Y5W8ZAK8.

prices.description: What each action costs in credits.

id.description: Format: a user id: usr_ followed by a 26 character ULID in upper case Crockford base32, such as usr_01JA0Q3V7XN3M9R6T1Y5W8ZAK8.

user.description: The signed-in person; null when the caller is an API key.
